adaptations.use: Decoder allocation, codec-parameter transfer, packet submission, frame receive, final null-packet drain and ownership cleanup. Application code validates every audio/video track, bounds indexed physical file ranges, rejects corrupt/concealed frames, supplies local-only cancellable AVIO and returns Qt-owned thumbnails.

Real codec-parameter and packet remuxing. Application test code duplicates or selects declared tracks, asks the mature muxer for fast-start MP4, and modifies specific physical later-packet bytes or final container bytes to produce malformed real files.

reviewedImplementation.focus: Atom-size tolerance, full sample index, partial packet reads and EOF.
Packet corruption, parser packet forwarding and I/O error propagation at EOF.
Custom AVIO, stream/index APIs, maximum streams and limitations of max_index_size.
Decoder error recognition, pixel/sample limits and send/receive semantics.

generatedSignals: The real H.264/AAC fixture encoder directly compiles the pinned mux.c and its documented duration/trailer fix from upstream.json; no decoder result or media packet is mocked.
